permissions._comment: MODEL (v3.9.5): Bash(*) allows all bash so runs flow without operator/env prompts. SAFETY = the deny list (deny overrides allow): git merge / force-push DENIED; other agent pushes are branch-scoped by the hooks (PUSH WALL below); home-dir reads (~/.nvm,.ssh,.aws,.config,etc) DENIED (no probing your machine); destroyers (rm -rf, publish, deploy) DENIED; in-project secrets (.env, auth, payments) DENIED. HARD-LOCKED: Edit and Write of .claude/settings.json are DENIED so no agent can rewrite these rules or remove the walls; a human edits this file by hand. Note Bash(*) stays allowed, so a raw shell write to this path is NOT covered by these tool-permission rules — the block-dangerous-git.sh PreToolUse hook closes that gap for full lockdown. PUSH WALL (v3.9.5): the blanket push deny moved into the hooks so the forge-loop can publish its PR branches: block-dangerous-git.sh blocks every push that is not exactly 'git push [-u] origin agent/<branch>', and loop-push-guard.sh validates that shape strictly (no force/delete/refspecs/other remotes). Merging stays walled by automerge-merge-guard.sh until the human runs /automerge on. This is Professor's allow-all-bash smoothness BUT keeping the mechanical git gate instead of Professor's prose gate — stronger, costs nothing.

hooks.command: f=$(ls -t ventures/*/STATE.md 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$f" ] && grep -qiE 're-?tier|rejected|REVISE|FAIL|escalat' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then if [ ! -f .claude/memory/learnings.md ] || [ "$f" -nt .claude/memory/learnings.md ]; then echo 'NUDGE (Hermes-style): a stage surfaced a lesson (re-tier/rejection/failure/escalation) but learnings.md was not updated. Distill ONE declarative, cross-venture fact into .claude/memory/learnings.md before ending. Facts not imperatives; skip anything stale in a week.'; fi; fi || true
